ucs.title: [LLM] LockBit (BITWISE SPIDER) pre-encryption recovery inhibition + log-clearing chain
ucs.description: Hunts the tight cluster of shadow-copy deletion, boot-recovery disabling and event-log clearing commands LockBit affiliates fire seconds before detonating the encryptor. The presence of two or more of these LOLBins on one host inside an hour is LockBit's signature 'inhibit recovery' staging, not benign admin work.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name IN ("vssadmin.exe","wmic.exe","bcdedit.exe","wbadmin.exe","wevtutil.exe") AND Processes.process IN ("*delete shadows*","*resize shadowstorage*","*shadowcopy delete*","*recoveryenabled no*","*bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures*","*delete catalog*","*delete systemstatebackup*","*cl *")) AND NOT Processes.user IN ("*$") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process _time span=1h
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| stats dc(process_name) as distinct_lolbins values(process) as cmds values(parent_process_name) as parents min(firstTime) as firstTime max(lastTime) as lastTime by dest user
| where distinct_lolbins >= 2
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
| sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where (FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("delete shadows","resize shadowstorage"))
    or (FileName =~ "wmic.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "shadowcopy delete")
    or (FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("recoveryenabled no","bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures"))
    or (FileName =~ "wbadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("delete catalog","delete systemstatebackup"))
    or (FileName =~ "wevtutil.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "cl ")
| summarize DistinctLolbins = dcount(FileName), Commands = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 20), Parents = make_set(InitiatingProcessFileName, 10), FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), LastSeen = max(Timestamp) by DeviceName, AccountName, bin(Timestamp, 1h)
| where DistinctLolbins >= 2   // >=2 distinct recovery-inhibition LOLBins in 1h = LockBit pre-encryption staging
| order by LastSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
ImProcessCreate
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
| where (ActingProcessName has "vssadmin" and ActingProcessCommandLine has_any ("delete shadows","resize shadowstorage"))
    or (ActingProcessName has "wmic" and ActingProcessCommandLine has "shadowcopy delete")
    or (ActingProcessName has "bcdedit" and ActingProcessCommandLine has_any ("recoveryenabled no","bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures"))
    or (ActingProcessName has "wbadmin" and ActingProcessCommandLine has_any ("delete catalog","delete systemstatebackup"))
    or (ActingProcessName has "wevtutil" and ActingProcessCommandLine has "cl ")
| summarize DistinctLolbins = dcount(ActingProcessName), Commands = make_set(ActingProcessCommandLine, 20), Parents = make_set(ParentProcessName, 10), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by DvcHostname, ActorUsername, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| where DistinctLolbins >= 2   // >=2 distinct recovery-inhibition LOLBins in 1h
| order by LastSeen desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: LockBit Pre-Encryption Recovery Inhibition and Log Clearing
status: experimental
description: Detects the shadow-copy deletion, boot-recovery disabling, backup-catalog deletion and event-log clearing commands LockBit affiliates run immediately before encryption.
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa23-165a
author: SOC Detection Engineering
tags:
  - attack.impact
  - attack.t1490
  - attack.t1489
  - attack.t1070.001
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  vssadmin:
    Image|endswith: '\vssadmin.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'delete shadows'
      - 'resize shadowstorage'
  wmic:
    Image|endswith: '\wmic.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: 'shadowcopy delete'
  bcdedit:
    Image|endswith: '\bcdedit.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'recoveryenabled no'
      - 'bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures'
  wbadmin:
    Image|endswith: '\wbadmin.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'delete catalog'
      - 'delete systemstatebackup'
  wevtutil:
    Image|endswith: '\wevtutil.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: 'cl '
  condition: 1 of (vssadmin, wmic, bcdedit, wbadmin, wevtutil)
falsepositives:
  - Scheduled backup-software maintenance windows that prune old system-state backups
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 ((@Image:(*\\vssadmin.exe OR *\\VSSADMIN.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*delete*shadows* OR *resize*shadowstorage*)) OR (@Image:(*\\wmic.exe OR *\\WMIC.EXE) AND @CommandLine:*shadowcopy*delete*) OR (@Image:(*\\bcdedit.exe OR *\\BCDEDIT.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*recoveryenabled*no* OR *ignoreallfailures*)) OR (@Image:(*\\wbadmin.exe OR *\\WBADMIN.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*delete*catalog* OR *delete*systemstatebackup*)) OR (@Image:(*\\wevtutil.exe OR *\\WEVTUTIL.EXE) AND @CommandLine:*cl*))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| (ImageFileName=/\\vssadmin\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/delete\s+shadows|resize\s+shadowstorage/i) OR (ImageFileName=/\\wmic\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/shadowcopy\s+delete/i) OR (ImageFileName=/\\bcdedit\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/recoveryenabled\s+no|bootstatuspolicy\s+ignoreallfailures/i) OR (ImageFileName=/\\wbadmin\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/delete\s+(catalog|systemstatebackup)/i) OR (ImageFileName=/\\wevtutil\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/\bcl\b/i)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName], function=count(field=ImageFileName, distinct=true, as=distinctLolbins))
| distinctLolbins >= 2

ucs.title: [LLM] LockBit mass-encryption: ransom-note drop + bulk .lockbit rename fan-out
ucs.description: Detects LockBit detonation by correlating a high-volume file-rename/write fan-out carrying LockBit extensions (.lockbit / 9-char random) with the actor's distinctive ransom-note filenames dropped per-directory. Tied to LockBit because of its specific note naming (random 9-char '.README.txt' in 3.0/Black, 'Restore-My-Files.txt' in 2.0) and per-folder note seeding behavior.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where (Filesystem.file_name="*.lockbit" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.README.txt" OR Filesystem.file_name="Restore-My-Files.txt" OR Filesystem.file_name="LockBit_Ransomware.hta") by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.file_name Filesystem.file_path Filesystem.process_id _time span=10m
| `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`
| eval is_note=if(match(file_name,"(?i)(\.README\.txt$|Restore-My-Files\.txt|LockBit_Ransomware\.hta)"),1,0)
| eval is_enc=if(match(file_name,"(?i)\.lockbit$"),1,0)
| stats sum(is_enc) as encrypted_files sum(is_note) as ransom_notes dc(file_path) as touched_folders values(file_name) as sample_files min(firstTime) as firstTime max(lastTime) as lastTime by dest
| where (encrypted_files >= 50 AND touched_folders >= 5) OR ransom_notes >= 1
| sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(1d)
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
| where ActionType in ("FileRenamed","FileCreated","FileModified")
| extend NoteHit = (FileName matches regex @"(?i)^[a-zA-Z0-9]{9}\.README\.txt$") or (FileName in~ ("Restore-My-Files.txt","LockBit_Ransomware.hta"))
| extend ExtHit = FileName endswith ".lockbit"
| where NoteHit or ExtHit
| summarize EncryptedFiles = countif(ExtHit), RansomNotes = make_set_if(FileName, NoteHit, 10), NoteCount = countif(NoteHit), TouchedFolders = dcount(FolderPath), FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), LastSeen = max(Timestamp) by DeviceName, InitiatingProcessAccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, bin(Timestamp, 10m)
| where (EncryptedFiles >= 50 and TouchedFolders >= 5) or NoteCount >= 1   // 50 encrypted files across >=5 dirs in 10m, or any note hit
| order by LastSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
ImFileEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
| extend NoteHit = (TargetFileName matches regex @"(?i)^[a-zA-Z0-9]{9}\.README\.txt$") or (TargetFileName in~ ("Restore-My-Files.txt","LockBit_Ransomware.hta"))
| extend ExtHit = TargetFileExtension in~ ("lockbit")
| where NoteHit or ExtHit
| summarize EncryptedFiles = countif(ExtHit), RansomNotes = make_set_if(TargetFileName, NoteHit, 10), NoteCount = countif(NoteHit), TouchedFolders = dcount(TargetFilePath), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by DvcHostname, ActorUsername, ActingProcessName, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
| where (EncryptedFiles >= 50 and TouchedFolders >= 5) or NoteCount >= 1
| order by LastSeen desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: LockBit Ransom Note and Encrypted Extension File Drop
status: experimental
description: Detects creation of LockBit ransom notes and files bearing the LockBit encrypted extension.
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa23-165a
author: SOC Detection Engineering
tags:
  - attack.impact
  - attack.t1486
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  encrypted_ext:
    TargetFilename|endswith: '.lockbit'
  ransom_note:
    TargetFilename|endswith:
      - '\Restore-My-Files.txt'
      - '\LockBit_Ransomware.hta'
      - '.README.txt'
  condition: 1 of (encrypted_ext, ransom_note)
falsepositives:
  - Rare legitimate files ending in .README.txt; pair with volume-based correlation for high fidelity
level: high
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=FileWritten
| (TargetFileName=/\.lockbit$/i OR TargetFileName=/[a-z0-9]{9}\.README\.txt$/i OR TargetFileName=/Restore-My-Files\.txt$/i OR TargetFileName=/LockBit_Ransomware\.hta$/i)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ContextImageFileName], function=count(as=fileCount))
| fileCount >= 50
